name: S32N79-RDB
photo_hints: Prefer a full top-down image of the board when possible.
For partial images around ID_SW3 or ID_JMP3X_A, include nearby connectors and silkscreen so the crop is not ambiguous.
Avoid glare on the DIP switch bank and black jumper shunts.
Keep the power-supply plug side consistent with the reference orientation when practical.
board_orientation_reference: vertical, power supply plug in the top-right corner
